name: 91 dominoes (double-12)
description: 91 dominoes (double-12) is a domino card game that involves tiles, matching, scoring. The game originated in China and has become popular worldwide.

content.text: 91 dominoes (double-12) is a domino card game that involves tiles, matching, scoring. The game originated in China and has become popular worldwide.
Double-12 set (91 tiles, 0-0 through 12-12). Block/draw dominoes; same matching rules. Largest common set; allows many players or long games.

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
Partnerships: Optional

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included

Standard 52-card deck
Score sheet (optional)
Table space

Cards per Player: Varies by player count
Dealing Pattern: Clockwise
--

items.text: Block: Players pass when they cannot play; no drawing from the boneyard. Game ends when no one can play. Lowest pip count in hand wins.
Draw: When a player cannot play, they draw from the boneyard until they can play or the boneyard is empty. First to play all tiles wins; if blocked, lowest pip count wins.
